items.title: Higher limits and BROWSE support for Unity Catalog secrets
items.text: A schema can now hold up to 1,000 Unity Catalog secrets, and a metastore up to 10,000, up from 100 and 1,000. The limits apply to Azure Databricks-managed secrets and secrets backed by Azure Key Vault. BROWSE on a catalog now applies to Unity Catalog secrets, so users can discover secrets and their metadata without being able to read the values or reference the secrets in code. See Privileges for Unity Catalog secrets.

items.title: OneLake external locations are in Public Preview
items.text: OneLake external locations are now in Public Preview. Use a OneLake external location as managed storage for a Unity Catalog catalog to store managed tables, volumes, materialized views, and streaming tables in Microsoft OneLake while Unity Catalog governs access. Workspace admins can control access to External location support for OneLake from the Previews page. See Connect Azure Databricks to a OneLake external location.

items.title: Databricks-provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will soon be enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
items.text: Starting in December 2026, Databricks-provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will be enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. The connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Atlassian, Slack, and GitHub. They let Genie One and Genie Code connect to third-party services to search your documents and data and take actions on your behalf. Azure Databricks governs each connection through Unity Catalog and Unity Gateway. See Databricks-provided MCPs, Connect Genie One to external tools and sources, and Connect Genie Code to MCP servers.

items.title: Lakeflow Designer October release
items.text: The Lakeflow Designer October release adds new AI Function and Prepare capabilities, an HTML operator, shareable full-screen previews, and tools for organizing large flows. The following updates are now available: Find operators by category: The Operators pane groups operators into input and output, clean, combine, transform, code, report, and canvas tools. See Built-in operators in Lakeflow Designer. Use ai_decide in the AI Function operator (Beta): Answer questions about text or parsed documents with probabilities, choices, or scores. See ai_decide function. Publish a custom operator to your workspace: In the operator panel, open a custom operator's actions menu and select Publish. The file switches to the published copy so you can reuse the operator in other visual data prep files.
